creation_path: Stage 3 research names the micro-niche and the gap (audience + occasion + style)
Write the design brief: your phrase, your concept, fonts with commercial licences — never a screenshot of a competitor's design
Produce the original design to spec: transparent PNG, 300 DPI, sized to the Printify print area; QC by eye (Stage 4)
Build the product in Printify (Stage 5) and price it with pipeline/pricing.py on REAL catalog costs
Generate the listing pack with pipeline/listing.py (Stage 6 SEO treatment), pass the publish gate (Stage 7)
delivery: Printify fulfils each order; Etsy collects payment; nothing ships from you
launch_checklist: Stage 1: intake answered — existing shop health-checked (Etsy Payments active, bank verified, shop policies set, production partners disclosed); no shop yet → appendix walkthrough first (docs/appendix-shop-creation.md)
Stage 2: Printify connected, Canada/US provider picked, print specs recorded
Stage 3: niche scored with pipeline/scoring.py — no candidate under the IP gate ships
Stage 4: designs original, 300 DPI transparent PNG, QC by eye, AI disclosure line ready
Stage 5: real Printify catalog costs in the pricing config; profit positive, Offsite Ads case survivable
Stage 6: listing pack generated; IP tripwire clean
Stage 7: human approves the exact product + pack; publish; read the live listing back
Stage 8: auto-fulfilment ON only after the first read-back; weekly review scheduled

summary: Original designs on tees, sweatshirts and hoodies, printed per order by a Printify provider. The pipeline's original path: Stages 1-8 as written. Research verdict (2026-11-23): generic tees and generic motivational quotes are saturated; micro-niches (audience + occasion + style) are where new shops get in.
